svg.title: Shop front
svg.desc: A high-street boutique: a dressed display window with a mannequin, a handbag, a hat box and pendant lamps behind the glass, a recessed glass door with an open sign, a sign band lit by gooseneck lamps and a hanging blade sign. A striped awning shades the window and folds up; planters, an A-frame board, carrier bags, a bin and a street lamp stand on the paved pavement beside the kerb.
